datasource_item.source_question_text:
7. A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0.
B. 𝑣0 cos 𝜃.
C. 𝑣0 sin 𝜃.
D. 0.
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
Q7. A soccer ball is kicked with speed \(v_0\) at an angle \(\theta\) above the horizontal. What is the speed of the ball when it is at the maximum height (ignore air resistance)?
A. \(v_0\).
This is incorrect because the vertical component decreases to zero at the top, reducing the total speed from its initial value.
B. \(v_0 \cos \theta\).
This is correct because at maximum height the vertical velocity is zero while the horizontal component remains \(v_0 \cos \theta\).
C. \(v_0 \sin \theta\).
This is incorrect because \(v_0 \sin \theta\) is the initial vertical component, which is not the speed at the top.
D. 0.
This is incorrect because the projectile still has horizontal motion at the top (unless \(\theta = 90^\circ\)).

D. None of the above is correct.
This is incorrect because option C correctly applies the impulse-momentum relation to the given numbers.
